text: Setting up alerts for pipeline failures — a different category from activator's data alerts.

An eventstream disconnecting or a notebook exception deserves a page right now. A single quality-check failure, already routed elsewhere, or a slightly slow query can just be logged and reviewed later.
If every minor blip pages someone, people start ignoring pages entirely — including the one time it's real. That's alert fatigue, and it's the most common reason alerting systems actually fail.
Severity tiers match the response to the actual stakes. Sev one pages immediately. Sev two waits for business hours. Sev three just gets logged — nobody's woken up for it.
The fix for fatigue is precision, not more alerts. Next up: cost management and optimization — knowing what a pipeline actually costs.
